title: CEMENTS & SEALERS
summary: Applied-material code table, part 1: plastisol sealer 9981257 (52a–52g, body bonding seams at dash/hinge pillar/underbody), sealer 9980664 (53a–53j, grommets, dash mat retainers, plenum panels), plastic seam cement 3753558 (54a–54c, lock pillar/door sill), black pumpable sealer 9985059 (55a–55e, heater seal, A/C evaporator, rear roof molding and weatherstrip) and adhesive 3711175 (56a–56e, body bonding, plugging holes). Assembly sheets cite these codes (e.g. 55d on the rear window sheet).
notes_internal: Chart sheet (no drawing, no callouts): applied-material codes. PART cell = GM part number + description from the left column, repeated on every row of its group (on the page it is printed once per group).
Words hyphenated across line breaks in USAGE are joined (e.g. RE-/TAINER -> RETAINER); multi-line cells joined with a space.
Model box reads 19000 (all models), so models = [].
54a UPC cell is wiped out by the binder hole; written '?'.
52f has blank UPC and SUB-GRP cells on the page.
52f usage: the final H of DASH runs into the column rule; read as 'HINGE PILLAR,DASH PANEL'.
56a UPC and 'SECTION O' print as a round O; taken as zero (UPC 0, sheet A8 = body bonding instructions).
No 55c row: gap between 55b and 55d; circled 2 sits there next to PUMPABLE. Rev 2 handwriting reads '55e' or '55c' (letter unclear), written '55?'; placement suggests 55c was removed.
Circled 4 and 1 beside 55e (removed rev 1, re-added rev 4); circled 3 beside 52g.
